newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian Nat Bank sets repo, leaves rates steady.
newsitem.headline: Austrian Nat Bank sets repo, leaves rates steady.

text.p: The Austrian National Bank said on Thursday it was calling for bids on one-week securities repurchase agreements at an unchanged 3.0 percent and was leaving its key interest rates steady.
Repo bids have to be in by 1100 GMT on Friday, the central bank said.
Last week the bank allotted 9.98 billion schillings, or 12 percent of bids, in repos.

The Austrian discount rate remains at 2.5 percent and the Lombard emergency financing rate at 4.75 percent. The Gomex money market rate stands at 3.4 percent. -- Janet McBride, Vienna Newsroom 43-1-531 12 254
